skill.summary: Post-completion self-review for coding agents that runs simplify, harden, and micro-documentation passes on non-trivial code changes. Use when: a coding task...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added explicit "fresh eyes" self-review step in the Simplify pass, requiring re-reading all added/modified code for bugs, errors, and brittle logic before edits.
- Clarified the skill’s philosophy: emphasizes disciplined, fresh review using peak context before any further coding steps.
- No changes to code or functionality; documentation improvement only.
- No functional or interface changes. Safe for all users.
